Mirrors a piece of the layer around the center, like a kaleidoscope.
Wraps the layer around a rotating 3D sphere with light and shine.
Rolls the layer around a rotating 3D cylinder with light and shine.
Twists the layer like a ribbon around an axis.
Two points suck in or push out the image, like liquid.
Cuts the layer into a grid of rotated, scaled tiles.
Repeats the layer around itself, with mirroring, bricks and blended edges.
Drags part of the image from one point to another, like a finger in paint.
Opens a tear in the layer between two points.
Slants the layer from a floor line; with a color it becomes a cast shadow.
Repeats the whole layer as smaller copies side by side.
Repeats a hexagon of the image in a honeycomb.
Blurs the image along its own shapes, like brush strokes.
Light rays burst from a point, carrying the image with them.
Turns the layer into dots that fly toward the viewer.
Pushes each color channel to full or zero by its own threshold.
Rotates each color channel by its own phase for psychedelic colors.
Scatters pixels like spray, with swirling twists.
Turns the image into thick, lit liquid blobs.
Shapes the image into embossed glass that refracts and shines.
Filters the layer with a 3×3 weight matrix (sharpen, emboss, edges).
Lights the layer with a soft-edged cone spotlight.
Raindrops fall on the layer and spread ripples across it.
Transition: the layer opens in half along toothed edges.
Transition: stretches the image from a line into streaks.
Transition: a hole opens at the center and pushes the image out.
Transition: the layer burns away like film, with glowing embers.
Transition: the image turns into ever larger blocks until it vanishes.
